title: Procedural opening of Committee of Supply debate on FY2026 Estimates
what_it_is: This is the procedural opening of the Committee of Supply debate on the FY2026 Main and Development Estimates; the transcript contains no policy substance.
why_it_matters: The record does not set out the practical impact.
what_happens_next: The Chairman will deal first with the Heads of Expenditure in respect of which amendments stand on the Order Paper Supplement.
not_said: Which Heads of Expenditure will be debated and in what order?
What do the 425 amendments to the Estimates of Expenditure propose?
What are the specific guillotine times for each Head of Expenditure?
When will the Committee of Supply complete its consideration of the Estimates?
What changes to public services or taxes, if any, do the Estimates make?
